content: ABOUT US Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. - We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. THE ROLE We're hiring an Internal Audit Manager to own our Business Process (BP) SOX controls program. You'll sit close to Finance and Internal Audit leadership, owning the risk assessment that shapes our controls universe and building testing processes from scratch. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role for someone who wants to build a program, not just run one. You'll be the primary coordinator with external audit and our co-source partner, and you'll bring a modern, tech-forward lens — actively applying AI to reduce manual testing effort and find efficiencies as the function scales. WHAT YOU’LL DO You'll work closely with Finance, process owners, external audit, and our co-source partner to build a rigorous, efficient business process controls program from the ground up. More than that, we believe you will thrive by taking ownership

...with particular focus on product development, operations, and commercial initiatives. Beyond strong legal judgment, we value curiosity, problem-solving, and a proactive mindset — looking for pragmatic solutions as we help redefine how legal work is done globally. What You'll Do - Act as a commercial legal partner to the business, working closely with senior stakeholders in Growth, Operations, and Procurement on customer and supplier engagements. - Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of customer and supplier contracts, with a strong focus on closing deals efficiently and pragmatically. - Advise on commercial risk allocation, pricing structures, liability, and contractual protections within customer and supplier agreements. Support go-to-market and procurement activities by enabling scalable, repeatable commercial contracting practices. - Address data protection and compliance considerations primarily within the context of customer and supplier contracts, ensuring risks are appropriately managed without slowing execution. - Develop and maintain commercial templates, playbooks, and guidelines to standardise negotiations and improve deal velocity. What You Bring - J.D. (or equivalent) with admission to practice in at least one U.S. state (or another common law jurisdiction). - 4+ years of experience at a top-tier law firm and/or as an in-house legal counsel. - Strong experience negotiating B2B SaaS agreements and supporting commercial teams. You’re an excellent negotiator. - Strong legal judgment and confidence in making decisions independently. - Experience in handling corporate matters and drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements. - Experience with data privacy matters, IT security and/or corporate law is a plus. - Your focus is on achieving meaningful business outcomes, translating into actionable advice delivered clearly and comprehensively. - You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic entrepreneurial environment and rapidly evolving business setting. You take initiative and are committed to delivering high-quality results. You are comfortable working independently and can effectively manage work across different time zones. - You are excited about

You’ll lead the delivery of complex change programs that span business teams, processes and technology. This means understanding what the business needs, getting deep enough into the technical detail to make sound recommendations, and bringing people together to turn decisions into working solutions. Your first major assignment will be our Workday implementation, partnering closely with the People Tech leader, business stakeholders and implementation partners. Member of Technical Staff, Infrastructure Engineer, Cloud Foundations As an Infrastructure Engineer in Cloud Foundations at Legora, you’ll build and operate the cloud foundations our products and engineering teams depend on. Your focus will be making our cloud environments secure, reliable and easy to use as we grow across Azure, AWS and GCP. You’ll turn infrastructure, access and governance into reusable code and self-service capabilities, helping teams move quickly with clear guardrails. What you will be doing - Build and maintain cloud accounts, subscriptions, networking and identity foundations across Legora’s cloud estate. - Develop reusable infrastructure as code with Pulumi and Crossplane and automate provisioning, configuration and routine operations. - Help teams get the environments and access they need through self-service tooling and clear documentation. - Partner with Security to implement cloud policies, access controls and automated compliance checks. - Improve visibility into resource ownership, cloud costs and capacity, and identify opportunities to reduce waste. - Operate the shared cloud foundations, improve their monitoring and alerting, and contribute to incident response and post-incident improvements. What you’ll bring Experience building and operating production cloud infrastructure, strong networking and identity fundamentals, and a software engineering approach to automation. You enjoy working with other engineering teams and making complex infrastructure simpler to use and maintain. Customer-Led Growth & Advocacy - Own the North American customer marketing strategy — building the advocacy engine that drives references, case studies, and community. - Define how customer stories ladder up to the category narrative and are deployed across the funnel. - Partner with Engagement and Community on adoption and expansion programs that move the needle on NRR across the region. Organizational Leadership & Operating Model - Own the full North American marketing P&L, allocating investment across regions, setting priorities, and reporting to marketing leadership with clarity. - Build and develop the North American marketing team, including regional Marketing Directors and their reports. - Set the operating model: define what good looks like, establish cross-regional processes, and build scalable ways of working without sacrificing speed, quality, or creativity. - Identify capability gaps and make the case for investment in people, technology, and programmes to close them. WHAT YOU BRING - 8–12+ years in B2B marketing, with meaningful time in senior leadership roles accountable for pipeline and revenue outcomes. - Experience building and leading marketing teams across multiple regions or markets.
